# netbox_owner_group (Resource)

Manages a NetBox owner group (`/api/users/owner-groups/`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Owner groups (NetBox 4.7+) organise owners, the teams accountable for objects.
resource "netbox_owner_group" "infrastructure" {
  name        = "Infrastructure"
  description = "Teams operating the physical and virtual infrastructure"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to an empty string.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.
- `url` (String) Url.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# netbox_owner_group is imported by its NetBox object ID (/api/users/owner-groups/).
terraform import netbox_owner_group.example 123
```
